pr_title: Make label sizing algorithm more robust
pr_body:
Fixes #73296.
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/73385.

This `Label` thing has been about to take me out of the few vestiges of sanity I still possess.

I've reworked the algorithm once more, in a way that it does everything needed to get the expected results while at the same time still looking sensible (not just a hardwire of contrived checks and bookkeeping to alleviate regressions.)

I've once more tested this to ensure the bugs in this unfortunate chain of issues are still dead like true poetry; namely:
- Catastrophic layout dance that freezes the editor upon an error in the Godot internal shaders.
- From https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/72387#issuecomment-1415344761:
  - Extremely tall script create dialog.
  - Project manager as it could look in a dream; that is, mostly normal, but with a lot of text missing.
- #73230.
- #72339.
- #73385.
- #73296, obviously.

I've also done some smoke testing by browsing different parts of the editor (help, some dialogs, etc.) to rule out potential new regressions. I have the impression that some user will be able to find one, though, but my gut feeling about the correctness of the code is now better than last time.

**UPDATE:** Added some related fixed bugs to the list.
pr_comments:
To help with reviewing the changes in a holistic manner, I made a custom branch with the 3 previous PRs reverted, and then the 4 PRs reapplied but squashed into one: https://github.com/akien-mga/godot/tree/label-lo
I.e. this commit can be viewed online and includes all the changes (this link with whitespace changes ignored): https://github.com/akien-mga/godot/commit/9bca9a7e8de43f6dfdde1ed2f7c4b22d2e200f5c?w=1

This should make it easier to review the whole set of changes as one chunk and make sure that all loose ends are tied.

Unlike our usual procedure, I suggest making further changes to this PR as separate commits so that the review can be based on https://github.com/akien-mga/godot/tree/label-lo + new commits in this PR (and we'll get it squashed before merge once approved).

In light of the retrospective diff, I've added one commit, which does the following:
- Cosmetic changes; most notably avoid extra `lines_visible`/`visible_lines` changes.
- Keep default min size calculation as the original did: `Size2(1, get_line_height())`, which makes more sense.

I went ahead and amended your fixup to my unified commit to make it smaller:
https://github.com/akien-mga/godot/commit/3881059d0062747a1aa6a8130904eb6cae8b476e?w=1

Compiled locally and started testing, here's the first problem I notice:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4701338/219033061-2cd449a3-8f5e-416e-8cc7-ff5be37df057.png)

I'm using 100% scaling with 1920x1080 resolution.

More screenshot comparisons of changed visuals in the editor:

| RC 2 | This PR |
| --- | --- |
| ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4701338/219034449-b94104f6-3f38-4f7f-98c7-3d29323836f2.png) | ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4701338/219034524-cf6ca718-dee6-4b84-9a8d-22579afa2e8b.png) |
| ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4701338/219034907-b048238a-65cc-4e26-a4f3-adfca6657d2f.png) | ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4701338/219034971-6b34a544-6902-4dac-a90c-e621f342a9e9.png) |

> Compiled locally and started testing, here's the first problem I notice:

Seems like a result of this change?

> Keep default min size calculation as the original did: Size2(1, get_line_height()), which makes more sense.

The version I was looking at before was not doing this, but now I'm able to reproduce it on macOS as well.

Yes. I think I was too reckless in not testing everything again after that change, given how slippery this slope is. That said, I think the idea of that change should stay, but will need some other change to avoid the new issues. I'll add another commit with that very soon.

Pushed with a commit that reverts the mentioned change. I realized (as I did when deeply in this, but I ended up forgetting) that the public `get_minimum_size()` function will already take the font size (plus other relevant values) into account and will use `1` as the minimum width where relevant. Therefore, this `minsize` variable just needs to be the strict bounding box of the text, with no further considerations such as "if text is empty, we need to at least consider 1-line height."

Sorry for the inconveniences. @akien-mga, feel free to test it now.
I'm compiling now to test. I think you can squash the commits already, I'm fairly confident this should be good to merge after I've confirmed it works as expected in the editor.

issue_context.title: [4.0 RC2] Label with autowrap and blank text does not show new text after the first frame
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0 rc2

### System information

openSUSE Tumbleweed, compatibility renderer

### Issue description

A regression from RC1, most likely due to #73234. If we have a Label node with no text and with an autowrap mode set to something other than `Off`, and then we try to change the text into something else, the new text does not appear. Changing the text again does work, as long as the text is not the same as the previous text.

It does seem to work properly if the change happens immediately in the first frame of the game, but it does not work if the text changes in any other frame. Resizing the game window also seems to make the text visible. This did not occur in RC1.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a new Label node with no text and set its autowrap mode to something other than off. Then, change the text of that label after the first frame, either with a timer, an `await get_tree().process_frame` signal, an AnimationPlayer, or anything at all. Run the project, and the label will still appear empty.

Alternatively, simply download the MRP linked below, and run it. The text "This doesn't appear" will not appear, and after one second, the text "This appears" will appear. The expected behavior would be for both texts to appear.
![Peek 2023-02-14 18-20](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35376950/218796325-34aaa491-a326-4f41-8b5d-f5079dad1038.gif)


### Minimal reproduction project

[BlankLabelBug.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/10734583/BlankLabelBug.zip)

review_comments: This change was the main one to get #73296 fixed, but that wouldn't be enough since it by itself would "unbalance" other parts of the algorithm, causing already fixed bugs to come back. That's why this PR had to go over the whole thing once again.
